metadata.boundary: Bounded-exhaustive for the RMNCH+A Strategy scorecard (42), LaQshya Annexure C (20), and RKSK framework indicator tables (99); current restricted portal dictionaries and newer child-health manuals remain in the evidence-gap register.
metadata.officialNamePolicy: The name and officialIndicatorName fields preserve the source-table wording, including historical terminology and typographical irregularities.
metadata.normalizationPolicy: Normalized measure, scale, formula and denominator fields are separate analytical metadata and do not overwrite the official/source expression.
